description: Korean card fields corresponding 1-to-1 with the numbered input schedule rows.

rows.description: One item per input row, in input order.

index.description: 1-based index matching the input row number.

title_ko.description: What the stream is, without participants, place, labels, or remarks.

place_ko.description: Where the stream airs or the event happens when it is not the poster owner's own channel; otherwise empty.

tags_ko.description: Fixed properties: stream language, platform, restricted access, sponsorship.

note_ko.description: Remarks about the plan; otherwise empty.

terms.description: Names and stream jargon rendered into Korean without a Glossary, Earlier renderings, Name table, or standing vocabulary entry.

source.description: The name as written in the row.

doubt_ko.description: Open points the row left undetermined; otherwise empty.
